column2: 558 transfer targets for 24 breaking dependency updates (BUs). For each BU, the fixing transformation generated by OpenCode/GPT-5.4-mini/JavaParser for the seed project (the first run that is an RQ1 compilable rule and passes RQ2 in 3 of 3 mvn test executions) is applied unchanged to every transfer target of that BU.

A client repository that declares the old version of the dependency, builds with it, and, after bumping to the new version, fails to compile with the same breakage as the seed: a compile error on the same broken API element (same symbol, same owner/package of the broken element, or the same call site). Non-fork copies are counted once: targets of the same BU whose Java sources are identical or near-identical (Jaccard ≥ 0.9 on the (path, content) multiset of .java files) and that are not in the same GitHub fork network are represented by the earliest-created repository.

2026-04-21 to 2026-10-20. GitHub code search (size-sharded), unmerged pull-request search and all-PR history search; no filter on creation date, activity, stars, size or archival status. One candidate commit per (repository, BU).

The rule is run on every source root of every module of the client (main and test sources, as declared in the poms; default src/main/java and src/test/java). A root the rule cannot parse is left unchanged. The build then runs `mvn clean test-compile` in a fresh container with the reproduction configuration (same JDK, build pom and plugin skips).

FIXED = the client compiles after the transformation; NO_MATCH = the transformation ran but changed no file; INCOMPLETE_MIGRATION = the transformation rewrote code but the client still fails to compile; TRANSFORMATION_ERROR = the transformation could not be executed.

For every FIXED client, `mvn clean test` was run 3 times before the update (client at "commit used", old dependency version) and 3 times after the transformation (new version + transformation), each run in a fresh container with the same build configuration (timeout 30 min). Per tree: PASS = 3/3 runs pass with at least one test executed; NO_TESTS = all runs pass but no test is executed; FAIL = no run passes; FLAKY = mixed; BUILD_ERROR / TIMEOUT otherwise. Columns "tests before update" and "tests after transformation" (Transfer_targets) give these classes (NA for non-FIXED clients). In Breaking_updates, "tests star" = at least one fixed client whose tests pass both before the update and after the transformation.

One row per BU (Table III): BU id, BUMP commit, library, versions, SemVer, seed project, API change types, reproduced clients (transfer targets), fixed clients, fix rate (%), fixed clients whose tests pass before the update / after the transformation / both, tests star; plus Total (pooled) and Mean per transformation rows.
One row per target: BU id, client repository, repository URL, commit used, discovered by, search date, fork (GitHub fork), owner, transfer result, tests before update, tests after transformation.
Search queries per BU (query strings reconstructed from the search code; result counts where they were logged).

Check out the client at "commit used", bump the dependency of the BU to its new version, apply the seed transformation of the BU (BigBag rules repository, GPT-5.4-mini/JavaParser) to every source root, and run `mvn clean test-compile` (and `mvn clean test` for FIXED). check_final.py recomputes Breaking_updates (Table III) from Transfer_targets.
